name: Phantom Garden of Living Mirrors
description: An enchanted garden where mirrors float like orbs, reflecting not reality but shifting gardens, flowers that bloom in reflected light.
prompt: A serene garden featuring floating mirrored spheres that reflect not the sky but ever-changing lush gardens, delicate flowers growing from the reflective surfaces, magical realism, soft diffused lighting
caption: Look into the mirrors and discover gardens that exist only in reflection. A phantom world awaits! 🪞🌸 #LivingMirrors #PhantomGarden #ReflectedWonder
